_doc: mac_dinh = cau hinh dung chung; kenh = cau hinh rieng theo tien to ten file.
Ten file KB_CHO/TERCO1_video01.txt -> tien to TERCO1 -> lay muc kenh.TERCO1.
model: ten config pocket-tts (english, portuguese, italian, spanish, french, german...).
voice: ten file giong mau nam trong thu muc voices/ (WAV 16-bit mono 10-30 giay la dep nhat).
nghi_ngan / nghi_dai / nghi_doan_dai: do dai khoang lang, tinh bang giay.
temperature: de null cho model tu chon; 0.3-0.5 = deu deu, 0.7-0.9 = nhieu cam xuc hon.
whisper_lang: de null cho tu suy ra tu model (english -> en, portuguese -> pt).
quantize: true = nen model xuong int8, nhanh hon ~27% va do RAM ~48% tren CPU Intel/AMD. Nen bat neu may doi cu hoac RAM 8GB. Chat luong giong khong doi.
whisper_model: tiny/base/small/medium. Chu trong SRT lay tu kich ban chu khong tu whisper, nen 'base' da du chinh xac va nhanh gap doi 'small'.
